rows.output: On the day of the referendum, I voted to remain in the EU, because I believe that the UK's departure from the EU would be a disaster for our country. rows.reference: To those who promoted the motion on Friday, all I would say is that when the country is ploughing towards a Brexit that will hurt households, businesses and our public services, I do not understand the desire to waste time and energy on my loyalty to the Labour party leader.

rows.output: But I was also very clear that I was not going to be a member of the Labour Party, or any other party. rows.source: Robyn Christie ti Melrose sọpé: ''Òṣùba lọ sọ́dọ̀ Ayr, wọ́n ṣàmúlò àwọn àǹfààní wọn lọ́nà tódára ju bí àwa tiṣe lọ.''

rows.source: Ìgbìyànjú ìṣẹ́jú ìkẹrìnlá ti Grant Anderson, ti a yípada nípaṣẹ̀ Frazier Climo, fi Ayr síwájú, ṣùgbọ́n káàdì aláwọ̀ òfééèfé kan fún onífìla ilẹ̀ Scotland Rory Hughes, tí Warriors fi sílẹ̀ fún ìdíje náà, gba Melrose láyè láti jẹ́kí àwọn nọmba sọ̀rọ̀ tí Jason Baggot sì sáré di ìgbìyànjú kan tí a kò yípadà mu.
rows.output: Grant Anderson's 15-minute cameo, converted by Frazier Climo, sent Ayr to the top of the table, but a 10-minute card for Scotland's Rory Hughes meant that the Warriors were down to 10 men for the rest of the game, which Melrose won, leaving the hosts with a number of injuries, including Jason Baggot, who was forced to leave the field.

rows.source: Climo fẹ ìléwájú Ayr lójú pẹ̀lú ìjìyà pẹnariti kan, saájú, ní ìdajì àkókò gan-an, ó gbá ayò wọlé lẹ́yìn náà ó yí ìgbìyànjú aláàdáṣe kan padà láti sọ ọ́ di 17-5 fún Ayr ní àkókò ìsinmi náà.
rows.output: Climo was brought on in the 17th minute for the injured Ayr, and he immediately made a big impact, scoring a goal in the first half and then another in the second half to help Ayr win 17-5 in the first half of the break.

rows.source: Ṣùgbọ́n Melrose bẹ̀rẹ̀ ìdajì ìdíje ẹlẹ́ẹ̀kejì náà lọ́nà tódára tí ìgbìyànjú Patrick Anderson, tí Baggot yípadà sì dín ìyàtọ̀ náà kù sí àwọn kókó máàrún.

This has made it difficult for Bolivia to access the Pacific Ocean, as it would require the construction of a canal through the Andes Mountains.

rows.reference: Many Bolivians will watch the ICJ ruling on big screens across the country, hopeful that the tribunal in The Hague will find in favour of Bolivia's claim that - after decades of fitful talks - Chile is obliged to negotiate granting Bolivia a sovereign outlet to the sea.

rows.source: Orilẹ-ede Àrìwá Kòríà sọpé kíkó àwọn àdó olóro dánù kòní ṣẹlẹ́ àyàfi tí òun bá leè gba orilẹ-ede US gbọ́
rows.output: North Korea has warned that it will take "strong measures" if the United States does not remove it from a list of countries that use "extraordinary and excessive" resources to combat the spread of the coronavirus.
rows.reference: North Korea says nuclear disarmament won't come unless it can trust US

rows.source: Aláàkóso Ọ̀rọ̀ Ilẹ̀ Òkèèrè ti orilẹ-ede Àrìwá Kòríà Ri Yong sọpé orilẹ-ede òun kòni kó àwọn ohun ìjà àdó olóro rẹ̀ dánù láilái bí kòbá leè gba orilẹ-ede Washingtọn gbọ́.
rows.output: The North Korean ambassador to the United Nations, Ri Yong, stated that his country will not be intimidated by the U.S.
rows.reference: North Korean Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho says his nation will never disarm its nuclear weapons first if it can't trust Washington.

rows.source: Ri ńsọ̀rọ̀ lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹ́ta níbi Ìpéjọpọ̀ Gbogbogbòò ti Àjọ Ìṣọ̀kan Àgbáyé náà.
rows.output: The meeting was held on Wednesday, 22nd of March, at the General Secretariat of the United Nations.
rows.reference: Ri was speaking Saturday at the United Nations General Assembly.

rows.source: Ó pe orilẹ-ede Àmẹ́ríkà láti tẹ̀lé àwọn ìlérí tí ó ṣe nígbà ìpàdé kan ní orilẹ-ede Singapore láàrin àwọn adarí tí ńbá ara wọn ṣe orogún náà.
rows.output: He called the United States to follow the examples of the leaders who were present at a summit in Singapore.
rows.reference: He called on the United States to follow through on promises made during a summit in Singapore between the rivals' leaders.

rows.source: Àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ rẹ̀ wá bí US. Akọwe ti Ilẹ̀ Òkèèrè Mike Pompeo ti ńṣe bí ẹnití ó wà ní bèbe àtítúnbẹ̀rẹ̀ ìjíròrò lórí ọ̀rọ̀ àdó olóró tóti dúró sójú kan ju oṣù mẹ́ta lẹ́yìn ti Singapore náà pẹ̀lú Kim Jong Un ti Àríwá Kòríà.
rows.output: The U.S. is waiting for the next step. The State Department's Mike Pompeo is still in the process of negotiating the details of the Singapore summit with North Korea's Kim Jong Un.
rows.reference: His comments come as US. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo seems to be on the verge of restarting deadlocked nuclear diplomacy more than three months after the Singapore with North Korea's Kim Jong Un.

rows.source: Ri sọpé ó jẹ́ ''àlá tí kò leè ṣẹ'' kan wipe àwọn ìjẹniníyà tó ńtẹ̀síwájú àti àtakò ti U.S. sí ìkéde kan tó ńparí Ogun Kòríà yóò mú Àríwá náà wá sórí àwọn orúnkún rẹ̀.
rows.output: It was a "false alarm" that the U.S. intelligence community and the U.S. military were preparing for a war with North Korea.
rows.reference: Ri says it's a "pipe dream" that continued sanctions and U.S. objection to a declaration ending the Korean War will ever bring the North to its knees.

rows.source: Washington ńsọ́raṣè láti faramọ́ ìkéde náà láijẹ́ wipe Pyongyang kọ́kọ́ gbé àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ pàtàkì láti kó àwọn nǹkan ogun dánù.
rows.output: Washington is concerned that Pyongyang will not take the necessary steps to disable its nuclear weapons.
rows.reference: Washington is wary of agreeing to the declaration without Pyongyang first making significant disarmament moves.

rows.source: Kim àti U.S. Ààrẹ Donald Trump fẹ́ ìpàdé ẹlẹ́ẹ̀kejì.
rows.output: Kim and U.S. President Donald Trump are expected to meet again.
rows.reference: Both Kim and U.S. President Donald Trump want a second summit.

rows.source: Ṣùgbọ́n ìsiyèméjì tótàn káàkiri wà wipe Pyongyang  kòfi ọ̀rọ̀ ṣeré nípa kíkọ àwọn nǹkan ogun tí orilẹ-ede náà rí bí ọ̀nà kan ṣoṣo láti jẹ́kí ààbò rẹ̀ dájú sílẹ̀.
rows.output: However, the current situation in Pyongyang is that the North Korean government is not transparent about the military capabilities of the country, which is a major concern for the international community.
rows.reference: But there is widespread skepticism that Pyongyang is serious about renouncing an arsenal that the country likely sees as the only way to guarantee its safety.

rows.source: Pompeo ńṣètò láti ṣàbẹ̀wò sí Pyongyang lóṣù tó ńbọ láti gbaradì fún ìpàdé ẹlẹ́ẹ̀kejì Kim-Trump kan.
rows.output: Pompeo is expected to visit Pyongyang to prepare for a second summit between Kim and Trump.
rows.reference: Pompeo is planning to visit Pyongyang next month to prepare for a second Kim-Trump summit.

rows.source: Àfihàn aṣọ wíwọ̀ ti ìlú Paris fi ìlà àṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀jáde tuntun ninu nǹkan àwọ̀sóri tópọlọ́kan lójú ọ̀nà rẹ̀ sí Òpópónà High nítòsí rẹ.
rows.output: The view from the top of the Eiffel Tower is a new perspective on the city of Paris, and it is a must-see attraction for anyone visiting the city.

rows.source: Bí o báfẹ́ mú ìgbéga bá àkójọpọ̀ ate-orí rẹ tàbí kí o dínàmọ́ òòrùn náà pátápátá máṣe wá a lọ síwájú mọ́.
rows.output: If you are not content with your current position, you should not be afraid to move up.
rows.reference: If you want to upsize your hat collection or completely block out the sun then look no further.

rows.source: Àwọn aránsọ Valentino àti Thom Browne sị́́ óju àkójọpọ àwọn asọ wíwọ̀ orí wọn eyiti o bùyààri fún àkójọpọ̀ SS19 wọn lójú ọ̀nà-eré náà eyiti o ta àkojọpọ̀ irúfẹ́ wọn yọ níbi Ọ̀sẹ̀ Àfihàn Asọ ní Ìlú Paris.
rows.output: Valentino and Thom Browne's Fall/Winter 2019 collection was presented on the runway in Paris.
rows.reference: Designers Valentino and Thom Browne unveiled an array of wacky oversized head gear for their SS19 collection on the runway which dazzled the style set at Paris Fashion Week.

rows.source: Àwọn ate-ori tí kòṣeé lò lọ́nà tóga ti gba Instagram pátá nígbà ooru yìí ti àwọn aránsọ wọ̀nyí sì ti fi àwọn ìṣẹ̀dá wọn tó ńṣẹ́jú síni ránṣẹ́ sí ìsàlẹ̀ àwọn ọ̀nà tóóró náa.
rows.output: Some of the most stylish people in the world have taken to Instagram this summer to show off their summer styles, and the results are stunning.
rows.reference: Highly impractical hats have swept Instagram this summer and these designers have sent their eye-popping creations down the catwalk.

rows.source: Iṣẹ́ ara-ọ̀tọ̀ kan tótayọ láti ọwọ́ Valentino ni ate aláwọ̀ búráùn tó-ń-fòlókè eyiti wọ́n fi àṣomọ́ tódàbí ìyẹ́ sí etí-òkè rẹ̀ tókún gbogbo orí àwọn àwòṣe náà.
rows.output: A custom-made suit from Valentino's Fall 2011 collection, which was inspired by the ancient Greek and Roman world.
rows.reference: The stand out piece by Valentino was an over-the-top beige hat adorned with a feather-like wide brim that swamped the models heads.

rows.source: Àwọn àṣomọ tí ìwọ̀n wọn pọ̀ lápọ̀jù ní àwọn ẹ̀gúsí-olómi tíwọ́n ṣe lọ́ọ̀ṣọ́, ate-orí oṣó kan àti ọ̀pọ̀n-òyìnbó kan - ṣùgbọ́n wọn kò rán wọn láti jẹ́kí ori rẹ móooru.
rows.output: The elders of the land were all gathered together to the house of the Lord, and the king's daughter was there among them, with all the people of the land.
rows.reference: Other over-sized accessories included bejeweled watermelons, a wizard hat and even a pineapple - but they are not designed to keep your head warm.

rows.source: Thom Browne tún ṣàfihàn àṣàyan ti àwọn ìbòjú tókọyìnsáyé - tíwọn sí dé láàkókò tóyẹ fún àjọdún Halloween.
rows.output: Thom Browne has turned the humble pumpkin into a high fashion statement - from the simple jack-o'-lantern to elaborate decorations for Halloween.
rows.reference: Thom Browne also revealed a selection of bizarre masks- and just in time for Halloween.

rows.source: Púpọ̀ ninu àwọn ìbòjú náà niwọ́n rán àwọn ètè wọn pa ti wọ́n sì jọ Olóri-ogun Hannibal Lecter ju àwọn asọ tó ńgbayì lóde ìwòyí lọ.
rows.output: The number of people who were killed in the attack was much higher than the number of people who were wearing the protective clothing.
rows.reference: Many of the colourful masks had sewn up lips and resembled more like Hannibal Lecter than haute couture.

rows.source: Ìṣẹdá kan jọ àwọn asọ ẹ̀rọ ìbẹ́lumi tí ó pé pẹ̀lu ẹ̀rọ amúnimílábẹ-omi àti àwọn awò ojú, nigbati òmíràn wò bíi òkòtó ohun mímu aládùn dídì bíi yìnyín tóti yo.
rows.output: A certain woman was wearing a white dress that was called "waterfall" and had a white shawl, when she was seen as a beautiful woman, like a young woman who was drinking a sweet drink.
rows.reference: One creation resembled scuba diving gear complete with snorkel and goggles, while another looked like a melted ice cream cone.

rows.source: Àtipé bí ó bá tẹ̀síwájú pẹ̀lú gbólóhùn asọ ìgbàlódé tó gbòòrò náà- ó ṣe oríire.
rows.output: And if you are with a group of people who are very wealthy - you will be the most important.
rows.reference: And if you continue the huge fashion statement- you are in luck.

rows.source: Àwọn olùwòran àrà sọtẹ́lẹ̀ wipe àwọn ate-ori títóbi tíwọn ńsomó àgbọ̀n náà leè máa wá ọ̀nà wọn dé àwọn òpópónà ńlá nítòsí rẹ̀.
rows.output: The experts believe that the large number of people who are infected with the virus will not be able to find a way to the other side of the country.
rows.reference: Style watchers predict that the enormous bonnets could be making their way to high streets near you.

rows.source: Àwọn ate-ori oníwọn-ńlá náà dé ní yàjóyàjó lẹ́yìn gìgìrísẹ̀ ti 'La Bomba', ate-ori tíwọn fi ìko hun pẹ̀lú etí oníwọn ẹsẹ̀ bàtà méjì ní fífẹ̀ eyiti wọ́n ńrí lórí gbogbo eniyan láti orí Rihanna dé Emily Ratajkowski.
rows.output: The latest collection of long dresses was unveiled at the launch of 'La Bomba', a long dress made of silk with a daring thigh-high slit, which was worn by everyone from Rihanna to Emily Ratajkowski.
rows.reference: The out-sized hats come hot on the heels of 'La Bomba', the straw hat with a two-foot wide brim that's been seen on everyone from Rihanna to Emily Ratajkowski.

rows.source: Àlẹ̀mọ́ ẹ̀ṣìn náà tówà lẹ́yìn ate-ori tóṣòro láti lò  tíwọ́n fọ́n káàkiri ojú-òpò ìbáṣepọ̀ ayelujara fi ìṣẹ̀dá ńlá miran rańṣẹ́ sísàlẹ̀ ojú ìrìn náá - àpò etíkun tíwọ́n fi ìko hun tí ó fẹ́rẹ̀ tóbi tó asọ ìwẹ̀lódò àwòṣe náà tí ó kó o jọ papọ̀.
rows.output: The new law aims to make it easier for people to access the internet, as it requires internet service providers to offer a more affordable and faster service.
rows.reference: The cult label behind the highly impractical hat that was splashed across social media sent another big creation down the catwalk - a straw beach bag almost as big as the swimsuit-clad model toting it.

rows.source: Àpọ raffia aláwọ̀ omi-ọsàn tóti jóna náà, tíwọn fi raffia gbá létí tíwọ́n sì fi awọ funfun kan ṣe ìfàlọ́wọ́ rẹ̀, ni ó dádúró yàtọ̀ níbi àkójọpọ̀ ti Jacquemus' La Riviera SS19 ní Ọ̀sẹ̀ Àfihàn Asọ ní Ìlu Paris.
rows.output: A raffia and white lace dress, with raffia details, was shown on the runway of Jacquemus' La Riviera SS19 collection in Paris Fashion Week.
rows.reference: The burnt orange raffia bag, trimmed with raffia fringing and topped with a white leather handle, was the stand out piece in Jacquemus' La Riviera SS19 collection at Paris Fashion Week.

rows.source: Ìlúmọ̀ọ́ká gbajúmọ̀ afasọdárà Luke Armitage sọ fún FEMAIL: ''Mo ńretí láti rí àwọn ate-ori ńlá àti awọn àpò ìfàlọ́wọ́ etíkun ní òpópónà ńlá fún ìgba ooru tókàn - bí aránsọ náà ti ṣèdá irú ipa títóbi yóò ṣòro láti fóju fo àwọn ìbéèrè fún àwọn àṣomọ́ oníwọ̀n-tópọ̀lápọ̀jù náà.
rows.output: Luke Armitage, a former soldier, told FEMAIL: 'I'm hoping to see some of the biggest waves and the best surfers in the world competing in the summer - as the event has such a big impact on the local community, it's hard to ignore the questions from the surfers about the event.
rows.reference: Celebrity stylist Luke Armitage told FEMAIL: 'I'm expecting to see large hats and beach bags arrive on the high street for next summer - as the designer has made such a huge impact it would be hard to ignore the demand for the oversized accessories.'

rows.source: John Edward: Àwọn ìmọ̀ èdè jẹ kòṣeémáàní fún àwọn ọmọ ìlú àgbáyé
rows.output: John Edward: The languages of the world are all the same for all the children of the world.
rows.reference: John Edward: Languages skills essential for global citizens

rows.source: Àwọn ilé ìwé olómìnira ti ilẹ̀ Sikọtiland ńsì ríipé àkọsílẹ̀ eyiti o lààmì-laaka wọn ninu ẹ̀kọ́ tótayọ sì wà síbẹ̀, tí èyí sì ńtẹ̀síwájú lọ́dún 2018 pẹ̀lú àkójọpọ̀ àwọn èsì ìdánwò miran, eyiti wọ́n fún lágbára nípa àṣeyọrí ẹnìkọ̀òkan àti alápapọ̀ ninu eré ìdárayá, iṣẹ́-ọwọ́, orin àti àwọn ìdáwọlé àwùjọ.
rows.output: The School of Architecture in the University of the Witwatersrand, Johannesburg, South Africa, has been a leader in the field of sustainable architecture, which has been evident in its research and projects since 2018, including various other research projects, which have been funded by the National Research Foundation, focusing on the individual and collective success in the fields of architecture, urban design, music, and social entrepreneurship.
rows.reference: Scotland's independent schools maintain a track record of academic excellence, and this has continued in 2018 with another set of outstanding exam results, which is only strengthened by individual and collective success in sports, art, music and other community endeavours.

rows.source: Pẹ̀lu àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ tíwọ́n tó ẹgbẹ̀rún lọ́nà ọgbọ̀n jákè-jádò Sikọtiland, àwọn ilé ìwé wọ̀nyí, ti igbìmọ̀ ti àwọn Ilé ìwé olómìnira Ilẹ Sikotiland ńṣojú fún. ńgbìyaǹjú láti máa pèsè iṣẹ́ onípele tódára jùlọ fún àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ àti àwọn òbí wọn.
rows.output: With the support of the 30,000 students of the University of the Witwatersrand, these institutions, represented by the Independent Students' Movement of the University of the Witwatersrand, are fighting to ensure that the struggle for a non-sexist society is continued by future generations of students and staff.
rows.reference: With upwards of 30,000 pupils across Scotland, these schools, represented by The Scottish Council of Independent Schools (SCIS), strive to deliver the best level of service to their pupils and parents.

rows.source: Àwọn ilé ìwé olómìnira ńlépa láti gba àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ wọn lárádi fún ẹ̀kọ́ tójinlẹ̀ tí o síga síi, iṣẹ́-ìṣe tíwọ́n yàn láàyò àti ipò wọn gẹ̵́gẹ́bí ọmọ ìlú àgbáyé.
rows.output: Public libraries aim to provide all citizens with access to a wide range of educational resources, and to promote the use of libraries as a means of social mobility and improvement in the quality of life.
rows.reference: Independent schools aim to prepare their pupils for further and higher education, their chosen career and their place as global citizens.

rows.source: Bí ẹ̀ka ètò ẹ̀kọ́ kan eyiti ó leè ṣàgbékalẹ̀ ètò tí ó sì leè ṣàmúlò ètò ìkẹkọ̀ọ́ ti ilé ìwé àṣetẹ́ra-ẹnilọ́rùn kan, a ńrí àwọn èdè ọ̀làjù tó ńtẹ̀síwájú bí iṣẹ́ kan tógbajúmọ̀ táyé-ńfẹ́ láàrin àwọn ilé ìwé.
rows.output: As a system of education that can accommodate the needs of a diverse group of students, including those with special needs, we are committed to providing a comprehensive and inclusive education.
rows.reference: As an education sector that can design and implement a bespoke school curriculum, we are seeing modern languages continue as a popular and desired subject of choice within schools.

rows.source: Nelson Mandela sọpé: ''Bí o bá sọ̀rọ̀ sí ọkùnrin kan ní èdè tí ó yé e, ìyẹn yóò wọ inú orí rẹ lọ.
rows.output: Nelson Mandela said: "If you talk to a man in a language he understands, it goes into his ears.
rows.reference: Nelson Mandela said: "If you talk to a man in a language he understands, that goes to his head.

rows.source: Bí o bá sọ̀rọ̀ sí i ní èdè tiẹ gan-aṇ̀ ìyẹn yóò wọ inú ọkàn rẹ lọ.''
rows.output: If you ask me in the language of the gods, I will look into your heart.
rows.reference: If you talk to him in his own language that goes to his heart."

rows.source: Èyí jẹ́ ìránnilétí tólágbára kan wipe a kò kàn leè gbáralé èdé Gẹ́ẹ̀si nigbati a báfẹ ṣàgbéró àwọn ìbáṣepọ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn eniyan latí àwọn orilẹ-ede miran.
rows.output: This is a very important reminder that we should not be too quick to judge the English language when we are dealing with the complex social interactions of people from other countries.
rows.reference: This is a powerful reminder that we can't just rely on English when wanting to build relationships and trust with people from other countries.

rows.source: Láti àwọn èsì ìdánwò àìpẹ́ ti ọdún yìí, a leè ríi pé àwọn èdè ló ńwà lókè àwọn tábìlì líìgí náà  pẹ̀lú àwọn òdiwọn ìṣọwọ́yege láàrin àwọn ilé ìwé olómìnira.
rows.output: From the experimental results, we can see that the languages are trying to find a way to the table of the law with the help of the free press.
rows.reference: From this year's recent exam results, we can see that languages are topping the league tables with the highest pass rates within independent schools.

rows.source: Àpapọ ìdá méjìdínláàdọrin ninu ìdá ọgọ́ọ̀rún àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ tí wọ́n kọ́ èdè ilẹ̀ òkèèrè lógba giredi Giga A.
rows.output: The total of 2,118 students from the 10th grade who took the English language exam in the 2019 Giga A High School Graduation Examination.
rows.reference: A total of 68 per cent of pupils who studied foreign languages achieved a Higher grade A.

rows.source: Àkọsilẹ̀ dátà náà, tíwọ́n gbà láti ọwọ́ àwọn ilé ìwé mẹ́rìnléláàádọ́rin tójẹ́ ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ SCIS fihàn pé ìdá méjìléláàádọ́rin ninu ìdá ọgọ́ọ̀rún àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ gba giredi A Giga ninu èdè Mandarin, nigbati ìdá méjìléláàádọ́rin ninu ìdá ọgọ́ọ̀rún ti àwọn tó ńkọ́ èdè Jamani, ìdá mọ́kàndínláàádọ́rin ninu ọgọ́ọ̀rún ti àwọn tó ńkọ́ èdè Faranṣe, àti ìdá mẹ́tàdínláàádọ́rin ninu ọgọ́ọ̀rún ti àwọn tó ńkọ́ èdè Sipeeni bákannáà gba giredi A.
rows.output: The data set, which is based on the scores of 3,000 students from 15 schools in the SCIS network, shows that 2,300 students in the top 30% of students in Chinese, German, French, and Spanish scored an A grade.
rows.reference: The data, collected from SCIS's 74 member schools, showed that 72 per cent of students achieved a Higher grade A in Mandarin, while 72 per cent of those studying German, 69 per cent of those studying French and 63 per cent studying Spanish also achieved an A.

rows.source: Èyì ńfihàn wipe àwọn ilé ìwé olómìnira ní ilẹ Sikọtilandi ńṣàtílẹ́yìn fún àwọn èdè ilẹ̀ òkèèrè gẹ́gẹ́bí àwọn ìmọ̀ tóṣe pàtàkì èyìtí àwọn ọmọdé àti àwọn ọ̀dọ́ yóò nílò láisì àní-àní lọ́jọ́ iwájú.
rows.output: This shows that the independent schools in Scotland are free to teach the languages of the country as they see fit, and that the children and adults will be able to use them without any restriction.
rows.reference: This demonstrates that independent schools in Scotland are supporting foreign languages as vital skills that children and young people will undoubtedly require in the future.

rows.source: Àwọn èdè nísinsìnyí, bí i̇ṣẹ́ yíyàn, niwọ́n ńmú pẹ̀lú ọwọ́ àpọ́nlẹ́ kaǹ gẹ́gẹ́bí àwọn iṣẹ́ STEM (sáyẹ́ńsì, tẹkinọlọji, ìmọ̀-ẹ̀rọ àti ẹ̀kọ́ ìsiró tójinlẹ̀) ninu àwọn ìlànà ìkẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ti àwọn ilé ìwé olómìnira àti níbiimíràn.

rows.reference: Trump is trying to help West Virginia Republican Senate candidate Patrick Morrisey, who is trailing in the polls.

rows.source: ''Kìí ṣe àmì rere kan fún Morrisey wipe àarẹ̵ níláti wá láti gbìyànjú láti fún un ní ìgbésókè ninu àwọn ìdìbò náà,'' ni Simon Haeder, onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ǹsì ti òṣèlú kan ní ilé ìwé Yunifasiti Ìwọ-oòrùn Virginia sọ gẹ́gẹ́bí Reuters ti wí.
rows.output: "Nothing good can come of this," said Simon Haeder, a historian at the University of Virginia, as quoted by Reuters.
rows.reference: "It's not a good sign for Morrisey that the president has to come to try to give him a boost in the polls," said Simon Haeder, a political scientist at West Virginia University, according to Reuters.

rows.source: Ife-ẹ̀yẹ Ryder tí ọdún 2018 Ikọ̀ orilẹ-ede USA fi ikùn tíwọ́n ní hàn fún ìjà láti jẹ́kí àwọn ìrètí wà láàyè bí wọ́n ti ńgbórí wọnú àwọn ayò ẹlẹ́yọ-kọ̀ọ̀kan ti ọjọ́ Àìkú
rows.output: The 2018 Ryder Cup was a success for the USA, and we were all excited to see the team in action.
rows.reference: Ryder Cup 2018: Team USA show stomach for fight to keep hopes alive heading into Sunday singles

rows.source: Lẹ́yìn àwọn sáà mẹ́ta eyiti ó fì sẹ́ẹ̀gbẹ́ kan, àwọn onímẹ́rin ti ọ̀sán ọjọ́ Àbámẹ́ta kàn leè jẹ́ ohun tí Ife-ẹ̀yẹ Ryder yìí nílò.
rows.output: Three months of work, and 14 days of leave, is what the Ryder Cup is all about.
rows.reference: After three one-sided sessions, Saturday afternoon's foursomes might just have been what this Ryder Cup needed.

rows.source: Dùgbẹ̀-dùgbẹ̀ ti ipá-atini tó ńfì náà jẹ ọ̀rọ̀ eré ìdíje tíwọ́n gbélẹ̀rọ pátápátá kan ṣùgbọ́n ọ̀kan tí àwọn olùdíje gbàgbọ́ ninu rẹ̀ nítòótọ̀, tí kòrí jù bẹ́ẹ̀ lọ rí ní irú àwọn ìdíje bíi ìwọ́nyí.
rows.output: The overall effect of the referee's decisions was a draw, which was a disappointing outcome for the team that had been favored to win, as they had been expected to dominate the game.
rows.reference: The swinging pendulum of momentum is a completely invented sporting concept but one that players truly believe in, and never more so than at competitions like these.

rows.source: Nítorínáâ níbo ni wọn yóò sọpé ipá-atini náà wà báyìí?
rows.output: So where will we be able to find the true meaning of our lives?
rows.reference: So where would they say the momentum is now?

rows.source: ''Wọ́n ti ní ìléwájú oníkókó-mẹ́fà àtipé nísinsìnyí ó jẹ́ mẹ́rin, nítorínáà a ńgbé ìyẹn bíi kékeré díẹ̀ ninu ipá-atini kan ní Èmi rò,'' ni Jordan Spieth sọ bí ó tì rìn jáde lọ fún ọjọ́ náà.
rows.output: "Today, we're going to be playing the sixth hole, and I'm going to be playing the fourth hole, so we're going to be playing a little bit smaller than usual in the afternoon," Jordan Spieth said as he walked off the course.
rows.reference: "They had a six-point lead and now it's four, so we are carrying that as a little bit of momentum I guess," said Jordan Spieth as he strolled off for the day.

rows.source: Ilẹ̀ Yuroopu ní àǹfààní náà, àní bí a ti ńretí, àwọn kókó mẹ́rin níwájú pẹ̀lú méjìlà díẹ̀ síi ninu ayò náà.
rows.output: The European Union is the largest economy, with four major banks and two major airlines in the game.
rows.reference: Europe have the advantage, of course, four points ahead with twelve more in play.

rows.source: Àwọn ọmọ ilẹ̀ Amẹrika, gẹ́gẹ́bí Spieth ti ńsọ, ròpé wọ́n ní afẹ́fẹ̵́ kékeré kan ninu àwọn ìtukọ wọn botilẹjẹ tí wọ́n sì ní ọ̀pọ̀ láti mú kí orí wọn yá nípa rẹ̀, tíkìí ṣe kékeré jùlọ bí irúfẹ́ ti Spieth àti Justin Thomas tí wọ́n gbá ayò papọ̀ ní gbogbo ọjọ́ tí ìkọ̀ọ̀kan wọn sì leè fi àwọn kókó mẹ́ta láti inú mẹ́rin.
rows.output: American golfers, such as Spieth, are in a small group of players who have won all four major tournaments, and they are also in a small group of players who have won at least two of the four majors in the same year.
rows.reference: The Americans, as Spieth says, feel they have a little wind in their sails though and they have plenty to be encouraged by, not least the form of Spieth and Justin Thomas who played together all day and each boast three points from four.

rows.source: Spieth ti ńjẹ́ olóró láti ìhà tójìnnà sí afẹ́fẹ́ síbi ewéko tútù tí o sì ńsíwájú nípa àpẹẹrẹ.
rows.output: From the first hole to the last, Spieth has been a force to be reckoned with, and he's been making waves in the world of golf.
rows.reference: Spieth has been lethal from tee to green and is leading by example.

rows.source: Àwọn igbe ìkọ̀ǹkọ̀ ti àjọyọ̀ di aláriwo púpọ̀ síi bí ìpín àkókò tirẹ̀ ti ńlọ, tí ó sì gbá ayò tóṣe pàtàkì kan sínú ihò láti gba ìdíje ìkẹrin ní gbogbo igun mẹ́rẹ̀ẹ̀rin nigbati òun àti Thomas ti fi méjì wà nílẹ̀ lẹ́yìn méjì.
rows.output: The crowd was cheering wildly as the two of us, Thomas and I, were about to compete in the final round of the competition.
rows.reference: Those guttural screams of celebration got louder as his round went on, sinking a crucial putt to take match four all-square when he and Thomas had been two down after two.

rows.source: Ayó rẹ̀ tógbá láti orí koríko eyiti ó borí ìdíje náà fún wọn níwọn pàdé pẹ̀lú igbe tójọra kan náà, irú eyiti ó nsọ fún ọ pé ó gbàgbọ́ wipe ikọ̀ ilẹ̀ Amẹrika kò tíì jáde kúró ninu èyí.
rows.output: He was also the first to win the competition from the grass, which he did with a great leap, a type of which he had never done before, and he said that the American dream had not yet been realized.
rows.reference: His putt that won them the match on 15 was met with a similar scream, the sort that tells you he believes that the American team is not out of this.

rows.source: Spieth sọpe ''O níláti gbẹ́ ilẹ̀ jìn gidigidi nítòótọ́ kí ò maá ṣàníyàn nípa ìdíje tìrẹ̀''.
rows.output: He said, "I have to move to a very big house so that I can't see the competition."
rows.reference: "You've really just got to dig deep and worry about your own match," Spieth said.

rows.source: Ohun ni gbogbo ìkọ̀ọ̀kan nínú àwọn agbábọ́ọ̀lù  gọ́ọ̀fù wọ̀nyẹn ti fi sílẹ̀ báyìí.
rows.output: It is all the same in the eyes of the Lord, whether you are a slave or a free man.
rows.reference: It is all each of these players has left now.

rows.source: Àwọn ihò méjìdínlógun láti ṣẹ̀dá máàkì kan.
rows.output: Two hundred and fifty-two holes to make a mark.
rows.reference: 18 holes to make a mark.

rows.source: ̀Àwọn agbá̀ gọ́ọ̀fù kan ṣoṣo tóní àwọn kókó púpọ̀ ju Spieth àti Thomas lọ láàrin àwọn ọjọ́ méjì tókọjá ni Francesco Molinari à̵ti Tommy Fleetwood, ìtàn aláìṣeéjàníyàn ti Ìfe-ẹ̀yẹ́ Ryder náà.
rows.output: The first round was led by a group of five players, including Spieth and Thomas, who were two strokes behind the leaders, Francesco Molinari and Tommy Fleetwood, who were the only two to shoot under par in the first two rounds of the Ryder Cup.
rows.reference: The only players with more points than Spieth and Thomas over the past two days are Francesco Molinari and Tommy Fleetwood, the indisputable story of the Ryder Cup.

rows.source: Àwọn ìbejì aláìṣeéṣàlàyé ṣùgbọ́n táyé ńfẹ́ ti ilẹ̀ Yuroopu jẹ́ mẹ́rin láti inú mẹ́rin tí wọn kòsí leè ṣe ohun tí kòtọ́ kankan.
rows.output: The two brothers who were not allowed to leave the house in Europe were four out of the four who were not allowed to do anything.
rows.reference: Europe's odd but adorable couple are four from four and can do no wrong.

rows.source: "Moliwood'' nìkan ni àwọn méjì tíwọn kògbá ayò ọlọ́wọ́kan lórí àkójọpọ̀ àwọn ayò fún ihò lọ́ọ̀sán ọjọ́ Àbámẹ́ta, ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n yàgò fún àwọn ayò ọlọ́wọ́kan bẹ́ẹ̀ ní òwúrọ̀ ọjọ́ Àbámẹ́ta, ọ̀sán ọjọ́ Ẹtì àti lẹ́yìn aago mẹ́ẹ̀sán òwúrọ̀ ọjọ́ Ẹtì.
rows.output: "Mo li wọ́n" ni àwọn méjì tí wọ́n ń gbàgbé ayọ̀ lórí àkójọpọ̀ àwọn ayọ̀ fún ìhò lọ́jọ́ àbámẹ́ta, ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n yàgò fún àwọn ayọ̀ tí wọ́n ń gbàgbé lórí àkójọpọ̀ àwọn ayọ̀ fún ìhò lọ́jọ́ àbámẹ́ta, òwúrọ̀ ọjọ́ Ẹtì, àti lẹ́yìn àago
rows.reference: "Moliwood" were the only pair not to shoot a bogey on Saturday afternoon, but they also avoided bogeys on Saturday morning, Friday afternoon and the back nine on Friday morning.

rows.source: Aré sísá yẹn, àti ọ̀nà náà tódàbí pé agbára wọn  ńsàn lọ́sì àti láti ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn èrò aláriwo tíwọn kòsì kórawọn níìjánu yìí ńmú àyà àwọn agbábọ́ọ̀lù gọ́ọ̀fù náà le wipe àwọn ni aláyò láti lù lọ́jọ́ Àìkú, àtipé kòní sí agbábọ́ọ̀lù gọ́ọ̀fù tó gbajúmọ kankan mọ́ láti fi èdìdì kan di ìsẹ́gun ti ilẹ Yuroopu kan tóṣeé ṣe náà bí òòrùn ti ńwọ̀ lórí Le Golf National ju Fleetwood tàbí Molinari lọ.
rows.output: And the winner is, and the way it was, the strength of the players was evident in the first two rounds, and from the third round onwards, the field was reduced to the top 30. The first round was played in the morning, and the second round in the afternoon, and the third round in the evening, and the final round in the morning.
rows.reference: That run, and the way their energy seems to flow both to and from this boisterous crowd cements that they are the players to beat on Sunday, and there would be no more popular player to seal a potential European victory as the sun sets over Le Golf National than Fleetwood or Molinari.

rows.source: Àní pẹ̀lú ìfẹ́ àtọkànwá àwọn méjèèjì lórí àwọn ihò tóyàtọ̀.
rows.output: And with the seven lamps for the lamps of fire in front of the golden altar.
rows.reference: Preferably both simultaneously on different holes.

rows.source: Ọ̀rọ̀ nípa ti ògo ilẹ̀ Yuroopù sì jẹ́ eyiti kòtìí dàgbà tó síbẹ̀síbẹ̀.
rows.output: The issue of the European house is that it is not a balanced house.
rows.reference: Talk of European glory remains premature, though.

rows.source: Bubba Watson àti Webb Simson ṣe iṣẹ́ kúkúrú nípa ti Sergio Garcia, akọni oníbọ́ọ̀lù-mẹ́rin náà, nigbati wọn fí i ṣe ẹnìkeji pẹ̀lú Alex Noren.
rows.output: Bubba Watson and Webb Simpson were the co-leaders with Sergio Garcia, the four-time major winner, when they were joined by Alex Norén.
rows.reference: Bubba Watson and Webb Simpson made short work of Sergio Garcia, the morning's fourballs hero, when he was paired with Alex Noren.

rows.source: Ayò ọlọ́wọ́kan lórí àkójọpọ̀ àwọn ayò fún ihò kan ati awọn oníbejì méji lóju mẹ́ẹ̀sán iwáju gbẹ́ ọmọ ilẹ̀ Sipeeni náà àti ọmọ ilẹ̀ Siwidin náà sínú ihò kan tí wọn kò fígbà kankan súnmọ́ rí láti leè jadé kuro ninu rẹ̀.
rows.output: One of the guests, a young woman, was sitting on a bench with two men, when she saw the two boys, she took them to the house of the Spaniard and the Swede, and she told them, "I will not leave you alone, because I do not want to be left alone with you."
rows.reference: A bogey and two doubles on the front nine dug the Spaniard and the Swede into a hole they never got close to climbing out of.

rows.source: Lọ́jọ́ Àìku, botiwukori, kòsí ẹnikan láti ràn ọ́ lọ́wọ́ jáde kúrò ninu ihò rẹ.
rows.output: On the seventh day, the Lord God had not yet sent rain on the earth, and there was no man to till the soil.
rows.reference: On Sunday, though, there is nobody to help you out of your hole.

rows.source: Àwọn bọ́ọ̀lu-mẹ́rin àti àwọn onímẹ́rin kan niwọ́n ńwúni lórí gidi láti súnmọ́ fún wíwò nitori àwọn ìbáṣepọ̀ tówà láàrin àwọn oníbejì, ìmọ̀ràn tíwọn fúnni, ìmọ̀ràn tíwọn kò fúnni àti ọ̀nà náà tí ọgbọ́n-àtiṣeǹkan fi leè yípadà lójú-ẹ̀ṣẹ̀ kan.
rows.output: Four types of cells and one type of tissue are present in the eye, which is a complex organ made up of many different types of cells, tissues, and structures.
rows.reference: The fourballs and foursomes are so fascinating to watch up close because of the interactions between pairings, the advice they give, the advice they don't and the way that a strategy can change in an instant.

rows.source: Ilẹ Yuroopu ti gbá ayò tódàra ju gẹ́gẹ́bí ikọ̀ kan títí dé ìhín tí wọn sì tígba ìléwájú pàtàkí wọnú ọjọ́ tógbẹ̀yìn náà ṣùgbọn sáà onímẹ́rin yìí pẹ̀lú fihàn wipe Ìkọ Orilẹ-ede USA ní ikùn fún ìjà náà tí àwọn kan, papàá jùlọ Apá-ti-Orilẹ-ede náà, ti ńsiyèméjì.
rows.output: Europe has been more successful than the United States in reducing the number of deaths from the pandemic, but the U.S. has a higher number of cases, particularly in the South, where the virus has been more severe.
rows.reference: Europe have played better as a team thus far and take a significant lead into the final day but this foursomes session also showed that Team USA has the stomach for the fight that some, especially Stateside, had been doubting.

rows.source: Ilẹ̀ Yuroopu gba ìléwájú 10-6 wọnú ọjọ́ àṣèkágbá Ife-ẹ̀yẹ Ryder.
rows.output: Europe won the Ryder Cup by 10-6 on the first day of the tournament.
rows.reference: Europe take 10-6 lead into Ryder Cup final day

rows.source: Ilẹ̀ Yuroopu yóò mú ànfààni alálàáfíà kan wọnú ọjọ́ àṣèkágbá ti Ife-ẹ̀yẹ Ryder náà lẹ́yìn tí yọrí jàde kúrò ninu àwọn ìdíje oníbọ́ọ̀lù-mẹ́rin àti àwọn onímẹrin ti ọjọ Àbámẹ́ta pẹ̀lú ìléwájú 10-6 lórí orilẹ-ede United States náà.
rows.output: Europe will be the first to experience the new technology of the Ryder Cup, which will be held on the first day of the month of October, with the first match starting at 8:00 a.m. local time.
rows.reference: Europe will take a healthy advantage into the final day of the Ryder Cup after emerging from Saturday's fourballs and foursomes matches with a 10-6 lead over the United States.

rows.source: Àwọn oní-ìmísí méjì Tommy Fleetwood àti Francesco Molinari ni o darí ìdojúkọ náà pẹ̀lú àwọn ìṣẹ́gun méji lórí Tiger Woods tó ńlàkàkà kan láti mú iye ayò tíwọn jẹ́ jìnnà ní Le Golf National dé àwọn kókó mẹ̵́rin.
rows.output: Two-time champion Tommy Fleetwood and Francesco Molinari led the charge with two rounds of 67 to keep the pressure on Tiger Woods, who shot a three-under 69 at the Albatros Course of the Le Golf National.
rows.reference: Inspired duo Tommy Fleetwood and Francesco Molinari led the charge with two victories over a struggling Tiger Woods to take their tally so far at Le Golf National to four points.

rows.source: Ikọ̀ ilẹ̀ Yuroopu ti Thomas Bjorn, tó ńlépa láti tún di ife-ẹyẹ̀ tí wọ́n pàdánù ní Hazeltine lọ́dún méjì tókọjá náà mu, jẹ́ gàba lé ikọ̀ ti ilẹ̀ Amẹrika kan eyiti ó ńsì ìbọn yìn ní oníbọ́ọ̀lù-mẹ́rin ti òwúrọ̀, tó sì gba ṣíṣẹ̀-n-tẹ̀lé náà ni 3-1.
rows.output: European Tour leader Thomas Bjorn, who was looking to regain the title he lost last year at the Hazeltine National, won the American Tour title at the 100th US Open, which was played on the same week, with a score of 3-1.
rows.reference: Thomas Bjorn's European side, bidding to retain the trophy they lost at Hazeltine two years ago, dominated a misfiring American side in the morning fourballs, taking the series 3-1.

rows.source: Orilẹ-ede U.S. náà fún wọn látakò díẹ̀ síi ninu àwọn onímẹ́rin náà, tíwọ́n sì borí ninu àwọn ìdíje méjì, ṣùgbọ́n wọn kò leè jẹun wọnú gbèsè náà.
rows.output: The U.S. team won two of the four matches, but they were unable to advance to the final.
rows.reference: The U.S. offered more resistance in the foursomes, winning two matches, but they could not eat into the deficit.

rows.source: Ikọ̀ ti Jim Furyk nílò àwọn kókó mẹ́jọ láti inú àwọn ìdíje ẹlẹ́ẹyọkan méjìla ti ọjọ́ Àìkú láti leè tún gba ife-ẹ̀yẹ náà.
rows.output: Jim Furyk's lead was reduced to two shots after a double bogey on the 72nd hole of the tournament.
rows.reference: Jim Furyk's side need eight points from Sunday's 12 singles matches to retain the trophy.

rows.source: Fleetwood ni ọmọ ilẹ̀ Yuroopu àkọ́kọ́ náà tójẹ́ ọ̀dọ́ tíkòní ìrírí láti gba àwọn kókó mẹ́rin léra-léra láìdúró nigbati òun ati Molinari tíwọ́n sọ lórúkọ ''Molliwood'' lẹ́yìn òpin-ọ̀sẹ̀ tópè fún àkíyèsí kan jẹ́ oníbejì ìkejì náà láti gba àwọn kókó mẹ́rin láti inú àwọn ìdíje àfisíde mẹ́rin ninu ìtan Ife-ẹ̀yẹ Ryder.
rows.output: Fleetwood was the European Tour rookie who led the most starts without a win when he and Molinari, who were partners in the Molliwood team, finished second in the final event of the season. He was the second rookie to lead the most starts without a win when he won four of the four tournaments in the four tournament Ryder Cup.
rows.reference: Fleetwood is the first European rookie to win four points in a row while he and Molinari, dubbed "Molliwood" after a sensational weekend are only the second pair to win four points from their opening four matches in Ryder Cup history.

rows.source: Léyìn tíwọ́n ti tẹ Woods àti Patrick Reed lórí mọ́lẹ̀ ninu àwọn oníbọ́ọ̀lù-mẹ́rin wọn búgbàmu  pẹ̀lú agbára láti borí Woods tí táyà ẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀ tijò àti ọ̀dọ́ ilẹ̀ Amẹrika tíkòni ìrírí Bryson Dechambeau nípaṣẹ̀ 5 àti 4 tórinlẹ̀ díẹ̀ síi.
rows.output: The duo of Woods and Patrick Reed won the first of the four-man team matches, beating Woods' rival, the American, Bryson DeChambeau, by 5 and 4 in a match that was more than just a game.
rows.reference: Having crushed Woods and Patrick Reed in the fourballs they then gelled superbly to beat a deflated Woods and American rookie Bryson Dechambeau by an even more emphatic 5&4.

rows.source: Woods, ẹnití ó wọ́ ara rẹ̀ kọjà ninu gbogbo àwọn ìdíje méji lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹ́ta, fi àwọn ìbújade iṣẹ́ ọpọlọ hàn lẹ́ẹ̀kọ̀kan ṣùgbọ́n nísinsìnyí ó ti pàdánù mọ́kàndínlógún ninu àwọn ìdíje mọ́kàndínlọ́gbọ̀n rẹ̀ ninu àwọn oníbọ́ọ̀lù-mẹ́rin àti àwọn onímẹ́rin àti méje láìdúró.
rows.output: Woods, who was the only player to compete in all two tournaments on Monday, produced a total of 16 shots under par in the two tournaments, and was the only player to finish under par in the 72-hole tournament and the seven-hole tournament.
rows.reference: Woods, who dragged himself through two matches on Saturday, showed occasional bursts of brilliance but he has now lost 19 of his 29 matches in fourballs and foursomes and seven in a row.

rows.source: Justin Rose, sinmi fún àwọn oníbọ́ọ̀lù-mẹ́rin òwúrọ̀ náà, ó padà sọ́dọ̀ akẹgbẹ́ Henrik Stenson ninu àwọn onímẹ́rin náà sí ìjákulẹ̀ 2 àti 1 ti Dustin Johnson àti Brooks Koepka - àwọn tówànípò ìkínni àti ìkẹta ni àgbáyé.

rows.source: Àtipé ìyẹn túmọ̀ si Johnny English aláìlọ́wọ́ fúnrarẹ̀, tíwọn ti fún níṣẹ́ bíi ọ̀gá ilé ìwé nílé iṣẹ́ tódùn un wò kan, ṣùgbọ́n fífún ni àwọn ẹ̀kọ́ aílàlákọsílẹ̀ nipa bí a ti ńjẹ́ òṣìṣẹ́ ọ̀tẹlẹ̀múyẹ̀ kan: àwọn ẹ̀fẹ̀ apanilẹ́ẹ̀rín níbí, bí English sooe ńfúnni ni irúfẹ́-Ilé-ìwé-ti-Àpáta ilé ẹ̀kọ́ ti amí ṣíṣe.
rows.output: But the real value of Johnny English lies in the fact that he is a true gentleman, and he is not afraid to show it.
rows.reference: And that means bumbling Johnny English himself, now employed as a schoolmaster in some posh establishment, but giving off-the-record lessons in how to be an undercover operative: some nice gags here, as English offers a School of Rock-type academy of spying.

rows.source: English níwọn ti gbé padà ní kíákía sí Whitehall fún ìbanisọ̀rọ̀ pàjáwìrì tí ó sì túnwà níṣọ̀kan pẹ̀lú ọ̀rẹ́ tímọ́tímọ́ tóńjìyà fúngbà pípẹ́ Bough, tí wọn ṣe eré rẹ̵̀ lẹ́ẹ́kan síi láti ọwọ́ Ben Miller.
rows.output: The English text is a translation of the Yoruba text, which states that the Whitehall project was a collaboration between the artist and the art director Ben Miller.
rows.reference: English is whisked back to Whitehall for an emergency briefing and reunited with his former long-suffering sidekick Bough, played again by Ben Miller.

rows.source: Bough ní báyìí ti dí ọkùnrin tóti gbéyàwó kan, tíwọn sọ mọ́ balógun ọko ogun abẹ́-omi kan, ipa àwọn igi bọ́ọ̀lú-àfigigbá onídùnnú kan ninu eyiti wọn ti fi Vicki Pepperdine ṣòfo díẹ̀.
rows.output: The crew of the destroyer HMS Bulldog, led by Lieutenant Commander Ian Ransom, intercepts a German U-boat, U-110, in the Atlantic Ocean.
rows.reference: Bough is now a married man, hitched to a submarine commander, a jolly-hockey-sticks role in which Vicki Pepperdine is a bit wasted.

rows.source: Nítorínáà Batman àti Robin ti mimu àwọn nǹkan mẹ̀hẹ gidigidi níbi Iṣ̵ẹ́ Ọ̀tẹlẹ̀múyẹ̵́ ti Ọbabìnrin Ọlọ́lá Jùlọ ti padà sẹnu iṣẹ́, tíwọn sì ńṣe aláàbápàdé obìnrin àrẹwà amúniṣagbère Ophelia Bulletova ti Olgs Kurylenko.
rows.output: Therefore, Batman and Robin have been very busy at the Theater of the Absurd, where the return of the actress, the beautiful Ophelia Bulletova, played by the Russian actress Olga Kurylenko, has caused quite a stir.
rows.reference: So the Batman and Robin of getting things terribly wrong on Her Majesty's Secret Service are back in action, encountering Olga Kurylenko's beautiful femme fatale Ophelia Bulletova.

rows.source: Ẹwẹ, adarí ìgbìmọ̀ ìjọba ǹsubú lọ́nà tóléwu lábẹ̵́ èèdì ti ọlọ̀pọ̀-èrò oníṣẹ́ ìmọ̀-ẹ̀rọ olówó rẹpẹtẹ tí ó sọpé òun leè yanjú awọn ìyọnu kọ̀m̀pútà ti orilẹ-ede Britain: aláàrékérekè Jason Volta, tí Jake Lacy ṣe.
rows.output: Yes, the leader of the opposition in the House of Commons, Jason Volta, who is played by British actor Jake Lacy, is a descendant of the first black British computer programmer.
rows.reference: Meanwhile, the prime minister is falling dangerously under the spell of the charismatic tech billionaire who claims he can solve Britain's computer woes: the sinister Jason Volta, played by Jake Lacy.

rows.source: English ati Bough bẹ̀rẹ̀ ìrìn-àjò gígùn ti àwàdà aláriwo kan: wọ́n múra bíi àwọn agbáwo, wọn fi iná sí ilé oúnjẹ tójọjú ilẹ̀ Faranse kan; wọ́n ṣẹ̀dá ìdàrúdàpọ̀ nìbití wọ́n ti ṣe fàyàwọ́ ara wọn wọnú ọkọ̀ oju-omi ọlọ́lá ti Volta; ti English sì ṣe okùnfà aáwọ̀ bí ó ti ńgbìyànjú láti lo agbékọ́rí láti fi ara rẹ̀ mọ inu ilé ti Volta náà.
rows.output: The English and the Bough were both part of a great journey: they were as close as two brothers, they lit a fire in the kitchen of a French house; they created a new path where they had previously walked together, and the Englishman took the lead in exploring the Volta River; the Bough, on the other hand, was left behind, its branches reaching out to the sky.
rows.reference: English and Bough begin their odyssey of farcical high-jinks: disguised as waiters, they set fire to a flash French restaurant; they create mayhem smuggling themselves aboard Volta's luxury yacht; and English triggers pure anarchy as he attempts to use a Virtual Reality headset to familiarise himself with the interior of Volta's house.

rows.source: Gbogbo àwọn ibi ìdúró níwọ́n fàyọ pẹ̀lú ìdanílójú fún àtẹ̀lé tógbẹ̀yín yẹn, ṣùgbọ́n bí ó ti jẹ́ eyiti ó fanimọ́ra àti aláriwo aláìkóraẹni-níìjánu tó yẹn, àwọn ohun díẹ̀ ninu TV àwọn ọmọdé wà nípa gbogbo nǹkan náà.
rows.output: All the bus stops are now equipped with real-time information displays, but as it is the one that is most visible and has the least amount of noise pollution, the children are more likely to use it.
rows.reference: All the stops are certainly pulled out for that last sequence, but as amiable and boisterous as it is, there's quite a bit of kids' TV about the whole thing.

rows.source: Nǹkan alábọ́de tórẹwà.
rows.output: The world is a beautiful place.
rows.reference: Pretty moderate stuff.

rows.source: ̀Àtipé bí ó ti rí pẹ̀lú àwọn sinnimá Johnny English N kò leè ran ara mi lọ́wó àfi kí ńronú: ṣe ilé iṣẹ́ sinnimá ilẹ́ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì náà kò leè fún Rowan Atkinson ni ipa kan eyiti yóò ṣe ìdájọ́ tòótọ́ sí tálẹ́ǹtì rẹ̀ ni?
rows.output: But what I've noticed with the Johnny English movies is that they're not really funny. They're just a bunch of slapstick humor. And I'm not sure if that's the best way to showcase Rowan Atkinson's talent.
rows.reference: And as with the other Johnny English films I couldn't help thinking: can't the British film industry give Rowan Atkinson a role that really does justice to his talent?

rows.source: Ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Labour ṣẹ wipé àwọn ti ńdọ́gbọ́n ètò kan fun àwọn ọmọ ilẹ̀ Britain láti ṣe iṣẹ́ ọjọ́ mẹ́rin lọ́sẹ̵̀ ṣùgbọn kí wọ́n san owó ọjọ́ máàrún fún wọn
rows.output: The Labour Party says that the government is planning to introduce a four-day work week for British workers, but they will not receive extra pay for it.
rows.reference: Labour denies it is devising a plan for Britons to work a four day week but be paid for five days

rows.source: Ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Labour ti Jeremy Corbyn fẹ́ lati ronú nípa ètò tóyàtọ̀ pátápátá kan eyiti yóò rísì kí àwọn ọmọ ilẹ̀ Britain máaṣe iṣẹ́ ọjọ́ mẹ́rin lọ́sẹ̵̀ - ṣùgbọn kí wọ́n gba owó fún ọjọ́ máàrún.
rows.output: The Labour Party, led by Jeremy Corbyn, is proposing a radical system that would see workers paid for four weeks' holiday, but they would also be required to work for a month to earn it.
rows.reference: Jeremy Corbyn's Labour Party is to consider a radical plan which will see Britons working a four day week - but getting paid for five.

rows.source: Ẹgbẹ́ náà ni wọn ròyin pé ó fẹ̵ àwọn olórí ilé iṣẹ́ láti fí àwọn ìfowópamọ́ tí wọ́n ṣe nípaṣẹ̀ ìyípadà ọpọlọ àtọwọ́dá sí àwọn òṣìṣẹ̵̵́ nípa fífún wọn ní àfikún ọjọ́ kan láti sinmi.
rows.output: The group was informed that he wanted to hire some of the top officials from the company to oversee the implementation of the new project, which would be carried out in phases over a period of three years.
rows.reference: The party reportedly wants company bosses to pass on savings made through the artificial intelligence (AI) revolution to workers by giving them an extra day off.

rows.source: Yóò ríi pé àwọn òṣiṣẹ́ gbádùn òpin ọ̀sẹ̀ ọlọ́jọ́-mẹ́ta kan - ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n yóò mú iye owó náà lọ ilé síbẹ̀.
rows.output: You will see that the workers are paid a monthly salary - but they will only take the money home in a few months.
rows.reference: It would see employees enjoy a three-day weekend - but still take home the same pay.

rows.source: Àwọn orísún sọpé èròǹgbà náà 'ṣe déédé' pẹ̀lú  ètò ọ̀rọ̀-ajé ti ẹgbẹ́ náà àti àwọn àgbékalẹ̀ láti dẹ̀gbẹ́ orilẹ-ede náà fún ojú rere àwọn òṣìṣẹ́.
rows.output: The leaders of the party 'suggested' the establishment of a new economic system for the country and the creation of new administrative structures to ensure a positive image for the party's policies.
rows.reference: Sources said the idea would 'fit' with the party's economic agenda and plans to tilt the country in favour of workers.

rows.source: Sísún sí ọ̀sẹ̀ ọlọ́jọ́-mẹ́rin kan ni Ìgbìmọ̀ Ẹgbẹ́ Àwọn Òṣìṣẹ́ ti fọwọsí bí ọ̀nà kan láti ṣàmúlò àǹfààní ti ọrọ̀-ajé tó ńyípadà náà.
rows.output: The 2014 budget was approved by the House of Assembly as a means to address the economic crisis that is currently affecting the country.
rows.reference: Shifting to a four-day week has been endorsed by the Trades Union Congress as a way for workers to take advantage of the changing economy.

rows.source: Orísun ọ̀gá Ẹgbẹ̵̇́ Òṣèlú Labour kan sọ fún Sunday Times:  'Àtúgbéyẹ̀wò ìlàna ètò kan ni a ńreti láti kéde saájú òpin ọdún náà.
rows.output: The leader of the Labour Party, Mr. Sunday Times, said: "We expect to announce a new strategy before the end of the year.
rows.reference: A senior Labour Party source told The Sunday Times: 'A policy review is expected to be announced before the end of the year.

rows.source: 'Kòní ṣẹ́lẹ̀ ni òòru ọjọ́ kan ṣùgbọ́n ọ̀sẹ̀ iṣẹ́-ṣíṣe ọlọ́jọ́-mẹ́rin jẹ ìmísí kan eyiti ó ṣe déédéé wọnú ìgbéṣẹ̀ ẹgbẹ́ náà láti túnṣe ìmúdúró ọrọ̀-ajé náà fún ṣíṣe ojú rere sí àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ àti bíi ọgbọn-àtiṣe ìdáṣẹ́sílẹ̀ ti ẹgbẹ́ náà.
rows.output: The day is not yet over, but the sun is already setting. The four months of the rainy season have been a time of great progress for the community. The rains have been abundant, and the crops have been bountiful. The people have been working hard, and the community has been thriving.
rows.reference: 'It won't happen overnight but a four-day working week is an aspiration that fits in with the party's approach to rebalancing the economy in favour of the worker as well as the party's overall industrial strategy.'

rows.source: Ẹgbẹ́ Òṣèlú Labour kòní jẹ̵̵́ aláàkọ́kọ́ láti fọwosí irú èròǹgbà bẹ́ẹ̀, pẹ̀lú Ẹgbẹ́ Òṣèlú Green tó ńṣe ìléri ọ̀sẹ̀ iṣẹ́-ṣíṣe ọlọ́jọ́-mẹ́rin kan nígbà ìpolongo ìdìbò gbogbogbòò lọ́dún 2017.
rows.output: The Labour Party has not yet decided whether to support the Green Party, including the Labour Party's candidate for the 2017 general election.
rows.reference: The Labour Party would not be the first to endorse such an idea, with the Green Party pledging a four-day working week during its 2017 general election campaign.

rows.source: Ìlépa náà ni gbogbo Ẹgbẹ́ Òṣèlú Labour kò tíì fọwọsí bíi odidi kan lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́, botiwukori.
rows.output: The party has been in the shadow of the Ẹgbẹ́ Òṣèlú Labour party, which has not been in the shadow of the Ẹgbẹ́ Òṣèlú Labour party.
rows.reference: The aspiration is currently not being endorsed by the Labour Party as a whole, however.

rows.source: Agbẹnusọ Ẹgbẹ́ Òṣèlú Labour kan sọpé: 'Ọ̀sẹ̀ iṣẹ́-ṣíṣe ọlọ́jọ́-mẹ́rin kan kìí ṣe ìlànà ètò ẹgbẹ́ àtipé kì i ṣe ohun tí ẹgbẹ́ náà ńronú lé lórí.'
rows.output: The Labour Party's candidate for the Ondo State House of Assembly election, Mr. Oloye, stated: 'The election is a four-day event and not a plan for the party to work on.'
rows.reference: A Labour Party spokesman said: 'A four-day working week is not party policy and it is not being considered by the party.'

rows.source: Olórí Ìjọba Alátakò John McDonnell lo àpérò ti ọ̀sẹ̀ tókọjá ti Ẹgbẹ Òṣèlú Labour láti gbé ìran rẹ̀ fún àyipadà ti òṣèlu ọwọ-òsì ninu ọrọ̀-ajé náà jade.
rows.output: The leader of the Labour Party John McDonnell used the Treasury Select Committee to push his vision of a radical change in the economy.
rows.reference: Shadow Chancellor John McDonnell used last week's Labour conference to flesh out his vision for a socialist revolution in the economy.

rows.source: Ọ̀gbẹ́ni McDonnell sọpé òun ti pinnu làti fi èékánná gba agbára padà kuro lọ́wọ́ 'àwọn olùdari tíwọn kò lójú' àti àwọn 'àwọn tó ńkórè' ninu àwọn ilé isẹ́ tó ńpèsè ohun ìgbáyé-gbádùn.
rows.output: Mr. McDonnell stated that he had decided to take back the reins of the company from the "inexperienced" and "unproven" management team in the company's executive suite.
rows.reference: Mr McDonnell said he was determined to claw back power from 'faceless directors' and 'profiteers' at utility firms.

rows.source: Àwọn ètò olóri ìjọba alátako náà túmọ̀ sí wipe àwọn oníìpín ìdókòòwò lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ ní àwọn ilé iṣẹ́ omi-ẹ̀rọ leè má gba gbogbo ìpín wọn padà nitoripe ìjọba ẹgbẹ́ òṣ̵èlú Labour kan leè ṣe 'awọn àyọkúrò' lori àwọn ìdí ti ìwàkiwà ti wọn lérò.
rows.output: The ruling party's system of checks and balances ensures that the government's spending is transparent, and that the public can hold the government accountable for its actions.
rows.reference: The shadow chancellor's plans also mean current shareholders in water companies may not get back their entire stake as a Labour government could make 'deductions' on the grounds of perceived wrongdoing.

rows.source: Ó tún fi ìdí rẹ̀ múlẹ̀ nípa àwọn ètò láti fi àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ sínú àwọn ìgbìmọ aláṣẹ ilé iṣẹ̵́ àti láti ṣẹ̀dá Àwọn Owó Alájọni ti Oníǹkan lati máa fi ìdá mẹ́wàá ninu ìdá ọgọ́ọ̀rún àwọn ìpìn ìdóòkòwò ti àwọn ilé iṣẹ́ aláàdáni fún àwọn abániṣiṣẹ́, ti wọn duro láti da àwọn èrè ìpìn ìdóòkòwò tí ó tó ẹ̀ẹ́dẹ́gbẹ̀ta pọ́ùn sápo.
rows.output: He also made provisions for the distribution of the surplus to the poor and the needy, and for the distribution of the land to the people.
rows.reference: He also confirmed plans to put workers on company boards and create Inclusive Ownership Funds to hand 10 per cent of private-sector firms' equity to employees, who stand to pocket annual dividends of up to £500.

rows.source: Lindsey Graham, John Kennedy sọ ''Ọgọ́ta Ìṣẹ́jú'' bóyá ìwáàdí ti FBI nípa Kavanaugh leè yí ọkan wọn padà
rows.output: Lindsey Graham, John Kennedy said "I'm not sure" whether the FBI's investigation of Kavanaugh will change anyone's mind.
rows.reference: Lindsey Graham, John Kennedy tell "60 Minutes" whether the FBI's investigation of Kavanaugh could change their minds

rows.source: Ìwáàdí FBI náà sínú àwọn ẹ̀sùn tíwọ́n fi kan Adájọ́ Brett Kavanaugh ti dá ìdìbò tógbẹ̀yìn lórí ìfàkalẹ rẹ̀ fún iṣẹ́ Ilé Ẹjọ́ Tógajùlọ duro fún ó kéré tán ọ̀sẹ̀ kan, tí ó sì ńgbé ìbéèrè náà lori boya àwọn ohun ti àjọ náà rí leè sún èyíkéyìí àwọn aṣojú-ṣòfin àgbà ti ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Republican láti fa àtìlẹyìn kuro.
rows.output: The FBI's investigation found no evidence of sexual misconduct by Supreme Court Justice Brett Kavanaugh, but it did not address the central issue of whether the behavior described by Christine Blasey Ford and other women was sufficient to disqualify him from the high court.
rows.reference: The FBI investigation into accusations against Judge Brett Kavanaugh has delayed a final vote on his nomination to the Supreme Court by at least a week, and raises the question of whether the bureau's findings could sway any Republican senators into pulling their support.

rows.source: Ninu ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹnuwò kan tó ńbọ́ sórí afẹ́fẹ́ lọ́jọ́ Àìkú, akọ̀ròyìn ''Ọgọ́ta Ìṣẹ́jú Scott Pelley béèrè lọ́wọ́ Àwọn Aṣojú-ṣòfin Àgbà John Kennedy àti Lindsey Graham bóyá FBI náà leè tú àṣírí ohunkóhun eyiti yóò darí wọn láti yí àwọn ọ̀kan wọn padà.
rows.output: In a press conference held on Tuesday, correspondent Scott Pelley asked the two senators, John Kennedy and Lindsey Graham, whether the FBI could release any information that would lead them to change their minds.
rows.reference: In an interview airing Sunday, "60 Minutes" correspondent Scott Pelley asked Republicans Sens. John Kennedy and Lindsey Graham whether the FBI could unearth anything that would lead them to change their minds.

rows.source: Kennedy farahàn bí ẹnití ó ńkó àkóyawọ́ ju akẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀ lati Gúúsù Carolina lọ.
rows.output: Kennedy was more liberal than his predecessor from South Carolina.
rows.reference: Kennedy appeared more open than his colleague from South Carolina.

rows.source: ''Mo fẹ́ sọ, bí a tì ńretí,'' ni Kennedy sọ.
rows.output: "I want to say, as we expected," said Kennedy.
rows.reference: "I mean, of course," said Kennedy.

rows.source: ''Mo sọpé lílọ síbi ìgbẹ́jọ́ náà, mo sọ, mo ti bá adájọ́ Kavanaugh sọ̀rọ̀.
rows.output: "I'm going to the party, I said, I'm going to talk to Kavanaugh."
rows.reference: "I said going into the hearing, I said, I've talked to Judge Kavanaugh.

rows.source: Mo pè é lẹ́yìn tí èyí ṣẹlẹ̀, tí ẹ̀sùn náà jáde, sọpé 'Ǹjẹ́ ó ṣe é?'
rows.output: I call to mind the time when this was done, when the sun rose, and I say, 'Did you do this?'
rows.reference: I called him after this happened, that allegation came out, said, 'Did you do it?'

rows.source: Ó jẹ́ ẹnití ó ṣọkàn gíri, tóti pinnu, láìsiyèméji.''
rows.output: He who has a strong will, who is determined, will not be turned back.
rows.reference: He was resolute, determined, unequivocal."

rows.source: Ìbò ti Graham, botiwukori, farahàn bí eyiti wọ́n ṣètò ninu òkúta.
rows.output: The Ibo of Graham, a botiwukori, farahan bi eyiti won seto ninu òkúta.
rows.reference: Graham's vote, however, appears set in stone.

rows.source: ''Ọkàn mi ti pinnu nípa Brett Kavanaugj àtipe yóò gba ẹ̀sùn abúgbàmu kan,'' ni o sọ.
rows.output: "My mind is made up about Brett Kavanaugh and I will vote to confirm him," he said.
rows.reference: "My mind's made up about Brett Kavanaugh and it would take a dynamite accusation," he said.

rows.source: Ọ̀mọwé Ford, Èmi kò mọ ohun tí ó ṣẹlẹ̀, ṣûgbọn Mo mọ èyí: Brett ṣẹ́ nípa rẹ̀ pẹ̀lù agbára,'' Graham fi kún un, tó ńtọ́kasí Chritine Blassey Ford.
rows.output: Ford's wife, I don't know what he did, but I know this: Brett was involved with her, with power," Graham said, pointing to Christine Blassey Ford.
rows.reference: "Dr. Ford, I don't know what happened, but I know this: Brett denied it vigorously," Graham added, referring to Christine Blasey Ford.

rows.source: ''Àtipe gbogbo ẹnití ó dárúkọ̀ kò leè jẹ́ ẹ̀ri sí i.
rows.output: "Whoever wants to be a witness must be truthful."
rows.reference: "And everybody she names couldn't verify it.

rows.source: O tí pé ọdún mẹ́rìndínlọ́gbọ̀n.
rows.output: He has summoned the thirty gods.
rows.reference: It's 36 years old.

rows.source: Emi kò rí ohunkóhun tójẹ́ tuntun ńyípadà.''
rows.output: I haven't seen anything new yet.
rows.reference: I don't see anything new changing."

rows.source: Kínni Àjọ̀dun Ọmọ Ìlú Àgbáyé náà àtipé Ǹjẹ́ ó ti Ṣe Ohunkóhun láti Din Ìṣé?
rows.output: What is the purpose of the United Nations and what has it done to prevent war?
rows.reference: What is the Global Citizen Festival and Has it Done Anything to Decrease Poverty?

rows.source: Lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹ́ta ìlú New York yóò gbàlejò Àjọ̀dun Ọmọ Ìlú Àgbáyé, ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ orin ọlọ́ọdọdún kan eyiti ó ní lórí-ìlà àwọn ìràwọ̀ púpọ̀ amóríwú tó ńṣeré àti ìlépa amóríwú tóbáa dọ́gba; fífi òpin sí ìṣẹ́ àgbáyé.
rows.output: On the third day of the New York City Marathon, the United Nations will host a concert of world music, which will feature performances by a variety of artists and bands, and will be broadcast live.
rows.reference: This Saturday New York will host the Global Citizen Festival, an annual music event which has a hugely impressive line-up of stars performing and an equally impressive mission; ending world poverty.

rows.source: Ninu ọdún ìkeje rẹ̀, Àjọ̀dun Ọmọ Ìlú Àgbáyé yóò rí ẹgbẹ-ẹgbẹ̀rún àwọn eniyan tó ńrọ́ lọsí Pápá Ńlá ti Central Park láti máṣe lọ gbádùn àwọn eléré bíi Janet Jackson, Cardi B àti Shawn Mendes, ṣùgbọ́n láti tún jẹ́kí àwọn eniyan mọ ìlépa tòótọ́ fún ayẹyẹ naa tííṣe fifi òpin sí ìṣẹ́ tóti bọ́sódi kí ó tó di ọdún 2030.
rows.output: In its seventh year, the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) will host the Global Education Summit in New York City's Central Park to address the learning crisis, which has seen millions of people miss out on education, including celebrities like Janet Jackson, Cardi B, and Shawn Mendes. The summit will focus on ensuring that all people have access to quality education by 2030.
rows.reference: Now in its seventh year, the Global Citizen Festival will see tens of thousands of people flock to Central Park's Great Lawn to not only enjoy acts such as Janet Jackson, Cardi B and Shawn Mendes, but also to raise awareness for the event's true goal of ending extreme poverty by 2030.

rows.source: Àjọ̀dun Ọmọ Ìlú Àgbáyé náà, eyiti wọ́n bẹ̀rẹ̀ lọ́dún 2012, jẹ́ àmúgbòòrò tí Iṣẹ́ Àkànṣe ti Ìṣẹ́ Àgbáyé, ẹgbẹ́ aláàtẹnumọ́ ti àgbáyé kan ńrétí láti fòpin sí ìṣẹ́ nípa mímú iye àwọn eniyan tó ńṣiṣẹ́ gidigidi nípa dídojú ìjà kọ ọ́ pọ̀síi.
rows.output: The 2012 Annual Conference of the International Association of Women in Social Sciences was a celebration of the Association's 50th anniversary, and it was organized by the Association's Women's Committee to honor the achievements of women in the social sciences.
rows.reference: The Global Citizen Festival, which stated in 2012, is an extension of the Global Poverty Project, an international advocacy group hoping to end poverty by increasing the number of people actively fighting against it.

rows.source: Láti leè gba tíkẹ́ẹ̀tì ọ̀fẹ́ fún ayẹyẹ náà (àyàfi bí ó báfẹ́ sán owó fún tíkẹ́ẹ̀tì ti ẸNI PÀTÀKÌ GIDI julo), àwọn tó ńlọ sí òde-eré nilati pari àwọn iṣẹ́ ṣíṣẹ̀-n-tẹ̀lé kan, tàbí ''àwọn iṣẹ́''bíi yíyọ̀ǹda ara ẹni fún iṣẹ́, kíkọ lẹ́tà i-meèlì si olórí láàgbáyé kan, ṣíṣe èyíkèyìí ninu àwọn ọ̀nà miran tóni ìtumọ́ lati jẹ́kí ìmọ̀ ìlépa wọn láti fòpin sí ìṣẹ́ pọ̀síi.
rows.output: To be able to take the best advantage of the situation (unless you are a very important person), those who are in the outside world must complete a series of tasks, or "works" as they are called, which include making a vow of abstinence from certain activities, so that they may be able to achieve their goals and put an end to the suffering of the world.
rows.reference: In order to receive a free ticket for the event (unless you were willing to pay for a VIP ticket), concertgoers had to complete a series of tasks, or "actions" such volunteering, emailing a world leader, making a phone call or any other meaningful ways to help raise awareness of their goal of ending poverty.

rows.source: Ṣùgbọn báwo ni Ọmọ Ìlú Àgbáyé ti ṣàṣeyọrí tó pẹ̀lú ọdún méjìlá tóṣẹ́kù láti mú ìlépa rẹ̀ ṣẹ?
rows.output: But how did the Son of the King of the World achieve such a great feat with only two arrows to fulfill his mission?
rows.reference: But just how successful has Global Citizen been with 12 years left to achieve its goal?

rows.source: Sé èròǹgbà fífún àwọn eniyan lérè pẹ̀lú ìpéjọpè àwọn eléré jẹ ojúlówó ọ̀nà kan rọ àwọn eniyan láti bèèrè fún ìpè kan fún iṣẹ́ ṣíṣe, tàbí i̇̀ṣẹ̀lẹ miran ti ohun tíwọ́n pè ní ''iṣẹ́ ṣíṣe bọ́tìnnì títẹ̀'' lásán - àwọn eniyan ńlérò wipr àwọn ńmú ìyàtọ̀ tóótọ̀ wá nípa bíbuwọ́lu ìbéèrè ojú-ópó ayelujara kan tàbí fífi àtẹ̀ránṣẹ́ tuwiti kan ránṣé?
rows.output: The internet has made it possible for people to connect with others all over the world, but it has also made it easier for people to be deceived.
rows.reference: Is the idea of rewarding people with a free concert a genuine way to persuade people to demand a call for action, or just another case of so-called "clicktivism" - people feeling like they are making a true difference by signing an online petition or sending a tweet?

rows.source: Láti ọdún 2011, Ọmọ Ìlú Àgbáyé ńsọpé òun to ṣàkọsílẹ̀ ''àwọn iṣẹ́ ṣíṣe'' tó ju mílíọ̀nù mọ́kàndínlógún lọ láti ọwọ́ àwọn alàtìlẹ́yìn rẹ̀, tíwọn ńtaari àpapọ̀ àwọn ìlépa tóyàtọ̀.
rows.output: Since 2011, the National Bureau of Statistics has reported that the number of "non-working" people in the country has exceeded 80 million, from 35.7 million in 2004.
rows.reference: Since 2011, Global Citizen says it has recorded more than 19 million "actions" from its supporters, pushing for a host of different goals.

rows.source: Ó ńsọpé àwọn iṣẹ́ ṣíṣe wọ̀nyí ti ṣe ìrànwọ́ láti ṣọ àwọn olóri àgbáyé ji láti kéde àwọn ìfiraẹnijìn àti àwọn ìlàna ètò tí ó ju bílíọ̀nù mẹ́tàdínlógójì dọ́là lọ eyiti wọ́n ti ṣètò rẹ̀ láti la ipa lórí ayé àwọn eniyan tóju bílíọ̀nù 2.25 lọ kí ó tó di ọdún 2030.
rows.output: They have been working on these projects for years to save the lives of millions of people by 2030, which will have a significant impact on the lives of billions of people, and they have set aside $3 billion to achieve this.
rows.reference: It says that these actions have helped spur world leaders to announce commitments and policies equating to more than $37 billion that is set to affect the lives of more than 2.25 billion people by 2030.

rows.source: Ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ọdún 2018, ẹgbẹ́ náà tọ́kasí àwọn ìfarajin àti àwọn ìkéde tí ó jáde láti inu àwọn iṣẹ́ ṣíṣe rẹ̀, ó kéré tán bílíọ̀nù mẹ́wàá dọ́là ninu eyiti wọ́n ti pín tàbí tíwọn ti kójọ.
rows.output: In 2018, the group released a report on the impact of its operations, which revealed that it had made $1 billion in revenue, of which $200 million was profit.
rows.reference: In early 2018, the group cited 390 commitments and announcements stemming from its actions, at least $10 billion of which have already been disbursed or fundraised.

rows.source: Ẹgbẹ́ náà ṣe àfojúdá àwọn owó tówà lábẹ́ ààbò eyiti ó ti la ipa tààrà lórí àwọn eniyan tó súnmọ́ mílíọ̀nù ẹgbẹ̀ta-léní-mọ́kàndínláàádọ́ta káàkiri àgbáyé.
rows.output: The group has been involved in the production of a number of products, which have had a significant impact on the lives of millions of people around the world.
rows.reference: The group estimates the secured funds have so far made a direct impact on nearly 649 million people across the world.

rows.source: Àwọn kan lára àwọn ìfaraẹnijìn pàtàkì ni Agbára Oúnjẹ Jíjẹ̀, aláàjọṣiṣẹ́pọ àwọn olùdóokoòwò àti àwọn amúṣẹ́ṣe ní orilẹ-ede UK tíwọ́n farajìn fún ''ṣiṣe ìrànwọ́ fún àwọn ọmọdé láti de ibi ipá wọn lẹ́ẹ̀kúnrẹ́rẹ́,'' tó ńṣe ìlérí láti pèsè mílíọnù márùndínlógójì dọ́là gún orilẹ-ede Rwanda latí fòpin sí àìtó oúnjẹ aṣaralóore ní orilẹ-ede náà lẹ́yìn tógba àwọn àtẹ̀ránṣẹ́ tuwiti tólé ní ẹgbẹ́rùn lọ́ná máàrún dín ní ọ̀ọ́dún lọ́wọ́ Àwọn Ọmọ Ìlú Àgbáyé.
rows.output: Some of the most important humanitarian issues include Food Security, which is a major concern for the poor and vulnerable in the UK, where millions of children are at risk of hunger and malnutrition. The government has pledged to address this issue by providing food aid to millions of people in Rwanda, where food insecurity is a major problem. The government has also committed to increasing the number of people in the country who have access to food, water, and sanitation.
rows.reference: Some of the key commitments include The Power of Nutrition, a U.K. based partnership of investors and implementers committed to "helping children grow to their full potential," promising to provide Rwanda with $35 million to help end malnutrition in the county after receiving more than 4,700 tweets from Global Citizens.

rows.source: ''Pẹ̀lú àtìlẹ́yìn láti ọ̀dọ̀ ìjọba orilẹ-ede UK, àwọn afúnnilówó. àwọn ìjọba orilẹ-ede, àti Àwọn Ọmọ Ìlú Àgbáyé bíi ìwọ, a leè sọ àìsí ìdájọ́ òdodo ìbaṣepọ̀ ti àìtó oúnjẹ aṣaralóore dí àkọsílẹ abẹ́-ẹṣé kan ninu ìtàn,'' àṣojú Agbára ti Oúnjẹ Jíjẹ Náà Tracey Ullman sọ fún àwọm èrò nigba ìpéjọpọ̀ àwọn eléré bóti ńwáyé ní ìlú Lọndọnu ní oṣu Igbe lọ́dún 2018.
rows.output: "With the support of the UK government, the Department for International Development, the Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs, and the Food Standards Agency, we can make a real difference in the fight against hunger and malnutrition," said Tracey Ullman, a representative of the Food Justice Network, during a meeting with the press in London in July 2018.
rows.reference: "With support from the UK government, donors, national governments, and Global Citizens just like you, we can make the social injustice of undernutrition a footnote in history," The Power of Nutrition ambassador Tracey Ullman told the crowd during a live concert in London in April 2018.

rows.source: Ẹgbẹ́ náà tún sọpé lẹ́yìn tí wọn ṣe àwọn iṣẹ́ ṣíṣe to ju ẹgbẹ̀rúnn máàrún lọ eyiti ó ńpè orilẹ-ede U.K. láti jẹ́kí ìmúdárasíi bá oúnjẹ jíjẹ fún àwọn ìyá àti àwọn ọmọdé, ìjọba náà kédé owó ìfifúnni fún iṣẹ́ àkànṣe kan, Agbára ti Oúnjẹ Jíjẹ, eyiti yóò leè fọwọ́kan àwọn ìyá àti àwọn ọmọdé mílíọ̀nù máàrún pẹ̀lú àwọn ìdásí oúnjẹ jíjẹ.
rows.output: The government also announced a new tax on a particular activity, the Energy of Food, which will affect millions of people, including children and the elderly, as well as the poor.
rows.reference: The group also said that after more than 5,000 actions were taken calling on the U.K. improve nutrition for mothers and children, the government announced funding for a project, the Power of Nutrition, that will reach 5 million women and children with nutrition interventions.

rows.source: Ní ìdáhùn sí òkan ninu àwọn ìbéèrè àwọn eniyan tówọ́pọ̀ jùlọ lori ojú-òpó rẹ̀ tó ńbéèrè ''kínni ó mú ọ ropé a leè fòpin sí ìṣẹ́ tó kọjá àlà?''
rows.output: In response to one of the most frequently asked questions by the public about his program, "What can we do to stop the madness that is beyond our control?"
rows.reference: In response to one of the FAQs on its website asking "what makes you think we can end extreme poverty?"

rows.source: Ọmọ ìlú àgbáyé dáhùn: ''Yóò jẹ́ ọ̀nà gígùn tí ó le kan - nígbà miran a ó súbu tí a ó sì kùnà.
rows.output: The people of the land said: "There is no path that you can take - in another time, we will be the ones who will be destroyed.
rows.reference: Global citizen replied: "It'll be a long and hard path - sometimes we will fall and fail.

rows.source: Ṣùgbọ́n, bí àwọn ẹgbẹ́ ajàfẹ́ẹ̀tọ́-ẹni àti eyiti ó ńlódì sí ìwà ẹlẹ́yàmẹ̀yà ńlá tó saájú wa, a ó ṣàṣeyọrí, nitoripe a ni agbára púpọ̀ síi lápapọ̀.
rows.output: However, as the people of the land and the people of the world are becoming more and more divided, we must be united, because we have a great power to bring together.
rows.reference: But, like the great civil rights and anti-apartheid movements before us, we will succeed, because we are more powerful together.

rows.source: Janet Jackson, àwọn The Weeknd, Shawn Mendes, Cardi B, Janelle Monáe wà lára àwọn kan ninu àwọn eléré tó ńṣeré níbi ayẹyẹ tọdún yìí ní ìlú New York, eyiti Deborah-Lee Furness àti Hugh Jackman yóò tijẹ́ àwọn olùgbàlejò.
rows.output: Janet Jackson, The Weeknd, Shawn Mendes, Cardi B, and Janelle Monáe are among the many artists who will perform at the global music festival in New York City, which will be hosted by Deborah-Lee Furness and Hugh Jackman.
rows.reference: Janet Jackson, the Weeknd, Shawn Mendes, Cardi B, Janelle Monáe are among some of the acts performing at this year's event in New York, which will be hosted by Deborra-Lee Furness and Hugh Jackman.

rows.source: Orilẹ-ede US leè lo Àwọn Ọmọ Ogun Ojú-omi fún ''ìdèná'' lati di àwọn ìkó-ọjà agbára ti ilẹ̀ Rọ́síà jadé fún títà - Akọ̀wé Ọ̀rọ̀ Abẹ́lé
rows.output: The US Navy can use "ships" to transport nuclear warheads from Russia - Akọ̀wé Ọ̀rọ̀ Abẹ́lé
rows.reference: US could use Navy for "blockade" to hamper Russian energy exports - Interior Secretary

rows.source: Washington leè ''bí ó bá di dandan'' leè yàsí ọ̀dọ̀ Àwọn Ọmọ Ogun Ojú-omi rẹ̀ lati dènà dídé ọjà àwọn nǹkan ti ilẹ̀ Rọ́síà, àti ni Ààrin Gùngùn Ìlà-oòrun, Akọ̀wé Ọ̀rọ̀ Abẹ́lé ti orilẹ̵-ede US Ryan Zinke ti fihàn, bí Washington Examiner tí yọ ọ̀rọ̀ rẹ̀ lò.
rows.output: Washington said, "If it is necessary, I will use my military force to protect the trade of the United States, and in the Middle East, the U.S. Navy's 5th Fleet, led by Rear Admiral Kurt Tidd, has been deployed to the region.
rows.reference: Washington can "if necessary" resort to its Navy to prevent Russian energy hitting the markets, including in the Middle East, US Internal Secretary Ryan Zinke has revealed, as cited by Washington Examiner.

rows.source: Zinke fẹ̀sùn kàn wipe ìbáṣepọ̀ ilẹ̀ Rọ́síà pẹ̀lú ilẹ̀ Síríà - níti àkíyèsi, níbití ó ti ńṣiṣẹ́ pẹ̀lù ìfìwépe ìjọba tóbá òfin mu náà - jẹ́ ọgbọń láti ṣáwàrí àwọn ọjà fún nǹkan agbára tuntun.
rows.output: Zinke said that the Russian Federation's annexation of Crimea - which is a violation of the international law, as it is a violation of the international law - is a precedent for the seizure of power in other countries.
rows.reference: Zinke alleged that Russia's engagement in Syria - notably, where it is operating at the invitation of the legitimate government - is a pretext to explore new energy markets.

rows.source: ''Mo gbàgbọ́ pé ìdí tíwọ́n fi wà ní Ààrin Gùngùn Ìlà-oòrun nípe wọ́n fẹ́ ṣe àdéhùn agbárs bí wọ́n tiṣe ni ìlà-oòrun Yuroopu náà, ikún gúúsù ti Yuroopu,'' ni iròyìn sọpé o sọ.
rows.output: "I believe that the current situation in the Middle East is a result of the same kind of agreement that was made in Europe, the southern part of Europe," the narrator said.
rows.reference: "I believe the reason they are in the Middle East is they want to broker energy just like they do in eastern Europe, the southern belly of Europe," he has reportedly said.

rows.source: Àti pé gẹ́gẹ́ bí òṣìṣẹ́ náà ṣe sọ, ọ̀nà àbáyọ wà tí a lè fi yanjú rẹ̀.
rows.output: And as the employee said, there is a way to solve it.
rows.reference: And, according to to the official, there are ways and means to tackle it.

rows.source: “Ó sọ pé “Oriléèdè United States ní agbára nípasẹ̀ àwọn ọmọ ogun orí omi láti rí i pé àwọn ojú ọ̀nà lórí òkun wà ní ṣíṣílẹ̀,Tí ó bá sì ṣe pàtàkì, wọ́n sì lè dí i tí ó bá yẹ láti rí i dájú pé wọn kò ọ̀jà agbára wọn tà .
rows.output: He said, "The United States has the power through its naval forces to keep the sea lanes open, and if necessary, to prevent the enemy from using their power to close them.
rows.reference: "The United States has that ability, with our Navy, to make sure the sea lanes are open, and, if necessary, to blockade, to make sure that their energy does not go to market," he said.

rows.source: Zinke ń bá àwọn ènìyàn tí ó wà níbi ìpàdé ti Ilé iṣẹ́ tí kò gbájúmọ́ eré jíjẹ Consumer Energy Alliance (Ajàfẹ́tọ̀ọ́ àwọn oníbàárà iná) ní US gbé kalẹ̀.
rows.output: Zinke is meeting with people at the Consumer Energy Alliance (CEA) meeting in the US.
rows.reference: Zinke was addressing the attendees of the event hosted by the Consumer Energy Alliance, a non-profit group which styles itself as the "voice of the energy consumer" in the US.

rows.source: Ó ṣe àfiwé ọ̀nà tí Washington ń gbà kojú orílẹ̀èdè Russia àti Iran pẹ̀lú àríwísí rẹ̀ ni pé bákan náà ni àwọn méjèèjì.
rows.output: He compared the way Washington was dealing with the countries of Russia and Iran with his criticism that both were similar.
rows.reference: He went to compare Washington's approaches to dealing with Russia and Iran, noting that they are effectively the same.

rows.source: “Ó sọ pe ọ̀nà àbáyọ ni ṣíṣe àwárí irúfẹ́ epo tí orílẹ̀ èdè Russia àti Iran ní níbòmíràn. Ó tún tẹ̀síwájú pé orílẹ̀èdè Russia ò ní ohun mìíràn tí wọ́n gbójúlé fún ọrọ̀ bí kò ṣe epo.
